title: Sales Coaching Template: 1:1 Agenda, Coaching Plan, and Call Review Form
summary: Copy a 30-minute 1:1 sales coaching agenda, a call coaching form, and a four-week coaching plan that tie one call to one behavior and the next call.
body_markdown:
Field


What to write


Rep, call date, call stage


For example: discovery call, second meeting


Who chose the call


Rep or manager. The agenda defaults to the rep; have the manager pick every other week.


Moment reviewed


Start and end time of a two- or three-minute stretch


What the buyer said


The exact words or a close paraphrase


What the rep said or did


The response, including the question the rep skipped


Scorecard criterion


The criterion this moment tests and its pass definition


Rating


Your scorecard's scale, for this criterion only


Evidence or interpretation


Mark each note E (in the recording) or I (your read)


What went well


One behavior to keep, with the time it happened


Behavior to coach


One observable change to propose in the 1:1


Retry scene


The buyer line the rep will practice against
